material_findings.title: NOMOS: static tool-call policy gates for LLM agents
material_findings.summary: Preprint proposes a four-pass policy-to-tool-gate compiler with schema-level static verification and reports substantial reductions in benchmark policy violations, with benign-utility costs. These are author-reported benchmark results, not independent security guarantees.
material_findings.verification: Primary arXiv abstract and metadata inspected; no implementation or benchmark reproduction completed.
material_findings.next_action: Compare policy-gate semantics against existing agent integration/authorization rules; design deterministic offline allow/deny/argument-schema fixtures and failure-closed tests before any implementation.

material_findings.title: PyCache Trap: Python bytecode execution gap in agent skill scanners
material_findings.summary: Preprint reports that inspecting visible Python source can miss behavior selected from bytecode caches, and proposes execution-aware validation. The paper-linked code repository returned 404 during this check, so its implementation and reported benchmark results could not be independently validated.
material_findings.verification: Primary arXiv abstract checked; GitHub metadata request for paper-linked repository returned 404. No attack execution or source-code import.
material_findings.next_action: Recheck linked code location and license; independently test a harmless local Python fixture showing source/cache mismatch and fail-closed admission, without importing untrusted code or executing arbitrary external skills.
